data.change_summary: Created docs/shrimp_state_contract.md (380 lines) — the prescriptive design contract for the stage-structured shrimp state model. The contract specifies: (1) three life stages (juvenile, sub-adult, adult) with per-stage reserve_g, condition_index, and maturation_accum; (2) population-wide molt state with explicit inter_molt_timer_days, molt_readiness, last_molt_success, and failed_molt_accum; (3) condition-dependent clutch size replacing the fixed 25 juveniles_per_clutch; (4) new ShrimpRuntimeParams for transition durations, condition thresholds, molt interval, and sub-adult weight; (5) serde-based save migration strategy from flat AnimalState to nested StageCohort layout; (6) explicit population-vs-individual boundary documentation and intentional omissions list. Updated scientific_inventory.md section 1.3 to annotate current flat shrimp fields as phase-1 simplifications with forward references to the new contract, and added an F1/F2 entry to the downstream bead handoff table. Added cross-references in ROUTING.md (retained share routes to per-stage reserve), scientific_specs.md (v0.5 shrimp realism section), and aquarium_sim_review_vnext.md (v0.5 section).
outstanding_risks: Per-stage reserve split has routing implications: the ROUTING.md consumer template currently describes a single retained destination. The cross-reference added is a pointer, but the full per-stage routing algebra (stage-weighted allocation of ingested food) will need a more detailed ROUTING.md update when F2 implements the model.

The sub-adult stage introduces a maturation delay that may shift long-horizon test outcomes (e.g., end_to_end.rs story scenarios, determinism.rs exact snapshot). The contract documents this in the test impact table but the actual test migration is deferred to the implementation bead.

Save migration from flat AnimalState to nested StageCohort: the contract proposes versioned deserialization, but if the struct shape changes more than expected during implementation (e.g., additional per-stage fields), the migration logic may need to be more complex than serde defaults alone. The contract specifies the exact target struct layout to minimize this risk.

Condition-dependent clutch size replaces the fixed 25 juveniles_per_clutch. The shrimp_population.rs test 'hatch_produces_juveniles' currently asserts exactly 25 juveniles per hatch event. This test will need updating to use envelope-based assertions when the implementation lands.

steps.description: Created docs/shrimp_state_contract.md — prescriptive design note covering chosen state model, per-stage fields, reserve/condition, life stage transitions, molt state, reproduction, population-vs-individual boundary, intentional omissions, extension points, migration strategy, struct layout sketch, downstream bead map, test impact table, and verification expectations.

Updated docs/scientific_inventory.md section 1.3: annotated adults_count/juveniles_count/berried_females_count row, condition/molt/repro indices row, egg tracking row, stress accumulators row, and maturation_accum row with forward references to shrimp_state_contract.md marking current fields as phase-1 simplifications. Added F1/F2 row to section 6 downstream bead handoff table.

Added cross-references: ROUTING.md consumer retained-destination note now points to per-stage reserve in shrimp_state_contract.md; scientific_specs.md v0.5 section references the contract; aquarium_sim_review_vnext.md v0.5 section references the contract.

Verified design note against existing test contracts (read-only). Confirmed shrimp_population.rs accesses state.animal.adults_count, condition_index, molt_stress_index, reproductive_readiness_index, and reserve_g as flat fields. Confirmed thermal_reproduction_penalty.rs accesses the same fields. The contract's migration strategy (versioned deserialization + backward-compatible accessors) and test impact table accurately map which tests need updating at implementation time. No test changes made by this design spike.
